intro.body: Spark Engineering & Contracting was established with a clear vision led by Consultant Engineer Mohamed Sharara, delivering a unique model in the contracting sector that combines high-level consulting precision with on-site mastery. philosophy.heading: Quality Begins
philosophy.body: In Damietta and other Delta governorates, the soil is characterized by its alluvial nature, high groundwater levels, and coastal salinity. These factors make foundation works and waterproofing a pillar that accepts no compromise. Spark adopts the highest specifications for moisture insulation and concrete protection from sulfate salts, because a truly luxurious building is one protected from its roots.
